input: Find arts, crafts, music, theater and dance summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Arden, Fletcher, Skyland, Fairview and Mills River, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Arden Fletcher summer camp art dance music 2026
dance summer camps Arden NC Asheville

candidates.name: Asheville Junior Theater / The Performing Arts Company of Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 musical-theater camps and dance intensives for ages 4–18, with crafts and final showcases.

candidates.name: Molly Angel Art Studio
candidates.note: Children’s summer camps in drawing, painting, clay and collage; separate introductory camp for ages 4–7.

candidates.name: Town of Fletcher Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 general day camp includes arts-and-crafts projects, swimming, field trips and outdoor activities.

candidates.name: NovusWay — Lutheridge
candidates.note: Children’s Music Week camps combine singing and a final performance with traditional overnight camp activities.

candidates.name: Project HNG
candidates.note: Farm summer day camp for ages 6–15 includes arts and horseback riding; formerly Hickory Nut Gap Farm Camp.

candidates.name: Camp Highlander
candidates.note: Overnight camp for ages 6–16 offers pottery, woodworking, painting, drama and jewelry making; 2027 registration announced.

candidates.name: Claying Around
candidates.note: South Asheville studio listed 2025 kids’ summer art camp with pottery, clay, glass fusing and canvas painting.

candidates.name: Firefly Valley Design / Firefly Valley Pottery
candidates.note: Youth pottery camps include handbuilding, wheel tutorials and natural crafts; ran in 2026 and announced 2027 registration.

candidates.name: Asheville Dance Theater
candidates.note: Themed summer camps for ages 3–10 combine dance, crafts and an end-of-week performance.

candidates.name: Asheville Music School
candidates.note: 2026 camps for ages 4–18 include rock, strings, ukulele, jazz, voice, Appalachian music and audio production.

candidates.name: Asheville Art Museum
candidates.note: 2026 weekly visual-art camps for rising grades K–12, with morning and afternoon sessions.

candidates.name: Asheville Community Theatre
candidates.note: Tanglewood Summer offers theater camps for ages 4–18; 2026 programs included musical productions and showcases.

candidates.name: Wortham Center for the Performing Arts
candidates.note: Ran 2026 Creative Arts Camp in partnership with ArtSpace Charter School.

candidates.name: Asheville Contemporary Dance Theatre / New Studio of Dance
candidates.note: Listed summer 2026 dance camps and intensives at its downtown Asheville studio.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 summer camps include creative activities alongside recreation; 2027 schedules will be published February 1.

candidates.name: University of North Carolina Asheville
candidates.note: Residential one-week ceramics program for rising high-school sophomores, juniors and seniors.
